name: sql-lab
description: Laboratório de SQL para diagnóstico e suporte a sistemas ERP

scripts.dev: npm run build --workspace=@sql-lab/shared && concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@sql-lab/shared && npm run build --workspace=@sql-lab/api && npm run build --workspace=@sql-lab/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace=@sql-lab/shared && npm run typecheck --workspace=@sql-lab/api && npm run typecheck --workspace=@sql-lab/web
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace=@sql-lab/shared && npm run test --workspace=@sql-lab/api && npm run test --workspace=@sql-lab/web
scripts.validate: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm run test
